item.title: Grappling with digital speed
item.description: Yassamine Mather dipped into the sessions on imperialism and Iran. The second session she attended was not only poorly presented, but the politics were awful. So, instead, she took to the ‘AI and capitalism’ stream. It proved much more interesting

item.title: See us home
item.description: Excerpt: Once again, we’ve fallen well behind, when it comes to the Weekly Worker fighting fund. True, over the last week there were some very useful contributions, but overall, in the last seven days, a mere £234 has come into the kitty - less than a tenth of that £2,750 monthly target.
item.dc:creator: Robbie Rix

item.title: So much to choose from
item.description: Tam Dean Burn followed the ‘Culture’ stream. Walter Benjamin was very much mentioned. But what particularly struck him was the presentation given by Håkan Thörn and Carl Cassegård on postapocalyptic environmentalism
item.dc:creator: Tam Dean Burn
